gold.title: The context is being created with d.Log instead of the log variable that was initialized with additional context values
gold.description: The context is being created with d.Log instead of the log variable that was initialized with additional context values (name, kind, method). This means those values won't be propagated to the logging context.

candidate.title: Delete puts the wrong logger into the context
candidate.description: Uses bare receiver logger instead of enriched log variable, causing downstream and legacy store logging to lack name, kind, and method fields

gold.title: Bug: calling recordLegacyDuration when storage operation fails should be recordStorageDuration.
gold.description: Bug: calling recordLegacyDuration when storage operation fails should be recordStorageDuration.

candidate.title: Storage/legacy duration metrics are recorded against the wrong series
candidate.description: Metrics recording inverts error flags: storage failures record as legacy errors and legacy delete-collection records as storage duration, making metrics unusable for gating mode-3 rollout

gold.title: Inconsistency: using name instead of options.Kind for metrics recording differs from other methods.
gold.description: Inconsistency: using name instead of options.Kind for metrics recording differs from other methods.

candidate.title: Delete's success path writes the object name into the 'kind' metric label
candidate.description: Per-object name passed to metric instead of options.Kind, causing unbounded cardinality growth and unaggregatable series

promotion_candidates.title: Async legacy writes are cancelled as soon as the HTTP handler returns
promotion_candidates.description: Goroutines derive timeout from inbound request context which is cancelled on handler return, causing legacy writes to abort with context.Canceled and creating divergence between unified and legacy storage

promotion_candidates.title: Panics in detached goroutines kill the Grafana process
promotion_candidates.description: Bare goroutines lack recover() on stack; panics in legacy store calls terminate the entire Grafana process instead of being handled by apiserver's panic filter

promotion_candidates.title: The new mode-3 integration tests actually run in mode 1
promotion_candidates.description: Mode transition logic lacks Mode2→Mode3 gate; all three new subtests exercise mode 1, leaving mode-3 code without integration coverage
